list.title: Library
list.lede: Sources, quotes and their authors — one place for every reference. You write texts in the Scriptorium and arrange knowledge (comments, people, places, events) in Knowledge; both cite from here. Everything is encrypted in the browser. Every area has its library: the area's members see it, and when the area is public — everyone. You work with all of them at once: references and search reach every library you can see.

list.sharedHint: A shared library is read and added to by everyone who has the area's key. Every area has one library.
